title: Settings navigation follows the Edit profile page layout
summary: Replace the floating settings navigation card with the shared full-height sidebar pattern and mono title/divider. Keep all settings sections mounted in the existing scroll document, preserve actions and deep links, and centralize cancellable section alignment for URL and local navigation.
dataSourcesChanged: None; existing settings panels, queries and mutation commands are unchanged
concurrencyRisk: Local navigation continues to suppress a competing URL-triggered scroll. The initial URL-alignment frame is canceled by later navigation or user scroll/input and cleaned up on unmount. Bounded settings sections retain real layout geometry rather than content-visibility placeholder heights, avoiding Safari target drift without timed retries. Existing settings component state remains mounted. No security, privacy or account action authorization changes.

rollback.strategy: Revert only the settings shell presentation and navigation alignment changes, restoring the prior floating navigation without changing persisted settings or unrelated workspace edits.
validation: All seven navigation sections and nested data-rights/deletion targets remain reachable
Existing settings commands and account confirmations remain intact
Section links preserve mounted fields and obey reduced-motion preferences

commands: npx eslint <changed settings and test files>
